services.name: Heritage Tour
services.desc: Gullah people are known for preserving more of their African linguistic and cultural heritage than any other African-American community in the United States. Duration 2.5 hours About Learn about the culture of Gullah people during a two-hour narrated bus tour, and other Hilton Head activities. The tours are narrated by native Gullah folks who are descendants of former slaves dating back to years immediately after the Civil War. You will travel through the Gullah communities on Hilton Head Island when the island’s landscape was only farmlands, trees, dirt roads, wildlife and natural waterways throughout and around the island.
